_schema.purpose: Described image library. At build time Claude reads this file and retrieves images BY MEANING (match slide intent against description + suggested_use + tags), then honors entitlement. See SPEC.md section 4 and .scratch/deck-tool/research/02-image-library-semantics-findings.md.

fields.entitlement: public | named-customer | mutares-family  (an image may appear only in a deck cleared for its entitlement; public is always allowed)
fields.description: one sentence of meaning; also reused as the
fields.suggested_use: message-level phrases in Oppr's own vocabulary (Capture -> Connect -> Execute, 'operators are the sensor')
fields.source: generated  (AI-made illustration; absent means a real photo/diagram/screenshot)
fields.generator: for source=generated: model + provider used, so the image can be reproduced
fields.prompt: for source=generated: the exact final prompt sent
fields.synthid: for source=generated: true, the file carries Google's SynthID watermark

_schema.sync: brand/img/index.html and its drift check are regenerated by tools/build-asset-index.ps1.

images.description: Polymer pellets and a cooling extrudate strand: the plastics industry, material only.
suggested_use: industry band for a plastics case
images.prompt:
Editorial industrial photography for a European manufacturing software brand. Warm, restrained, documentary; natural light, no studio gloss, no lens flare. Muted palette built on warm paper tones and desaturated industrial greys, with terracotta and deep teal reading only as incidental accents in the scene. Shallow depth of field, honest materials and real wear. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no signage, no watermarks. No brand marks of any kind and no recognisable company identity. Composed with calm negative space so the frame can be cropped to a wide band.

Extreme close-up of translucent amber and natural polymer pellets heaped on a brushed steel surface, with a single warm extrudate strand cooling in soft focus behind them. Granular texture, honest material, calm and quiet. No people, no machinery identity, no packaging.

suggested_use: industry band for a municipal waste recycling case
